name: Cyient Limited

profile.summary: Cyient Limited provides geospatial, engineering design, manufacturing, networks and operations, data transformation, and analytic services in North America, Europe, Middle East, and the Asia Pacific. The company operates through three segments: Digital, Engineering & Technology; Design Led Manufacturing; and Others. The company offers digital thread; electrification and energy storage; autonomous systems; digital twin; product to platform engineering; data platforms and GenAI; Industry 4.0; industry AI advisor platform; Coddy, a legacy application migration; CYARC, a regulatory compliance watch for medical devices; CYFAST, for equipment testing and validation; CYIOPS, a power outage planning
